definitions.explanation: meat cut from the thigh or upper leg of an animal, especially chicken, beef, or pork

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もも{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I bought some chicken thigh meat.

examples.japanese: もも{肉|にく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧ジューシーだ。
examples.english: Thigh meat is fatty and juicy.

examples.japanese: からあげ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{胸肉|むねにく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧もも{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧やわらかく⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: Karaage turns out more tender when you use thigh meat rather than breast meat.

notes:
Composed of もも (thigh) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat). One of the most common meat cut terms in Japanese cooking and shopping. Can be written as {腿肉|ももにく} in kanji, but the hiragana-kanji mix is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鶏|とり}もも{肉|にく}: chicken thigh meat
- {牛|ぎゅう}もも{肉|にく}: beef round/thigh
- {豚|ぶた}もも{肉|にく}: pork leg meat
- もも{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill thigh meat
- {骨|ほね}つきもも{肉|にく}: bone-in thigh meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胸肉|むねにく}: breast meat — leaner and drier than thigh meat
- {手羽先|てばさき}: chicken wing tip
- {手羽元|てばもと}: chicken drumette
- ささみ: chicken tender/fillet — the leanest part of the chicken
